title: H3XY/Entangle: quantum machine learning on quantum-native data, with classical-shadow baselines and IBM hardware runs
description: Code, result files, raw IBM Quantum counts and transpiled circuits, and job identifiers for the quantum-data part of "Where Small Quantum Classifiers Help, and Where They Don't: Fair Baselines and Real-Hardware Results on IBM Heron". It covers: entanglement and phase classification with 1-copy and 2-copy QNNs and a QCNN, against classical learners on state vectors and classical-shadow snapshots; a pure-vs-mixed (global purity) task in which a learned 2-copy SWAP test needs 16-64 copies while classical shadows need 128-4,096 for 2-6 qubits; 5-seed uncertainty, validation-based model selection and a gradient-variance (barren plateau) study; a Z2 lattice gauge theory toy model; and 2-qubit purity, entanglement and Ising runs on ibm_marrakesh with identical-circuit FakeMarrakesh replays.
